_doc: STAGING. The Shop is barbershop and salon merged — apart they yielded 6 and 9 boards, together 26. They were never two languages. The wait, the chair, the mirror, the standing appointment and the argument are shared; the split filed one vocabulary under two headings. Boards are drawn from both rooms and neither is treated as the default.

theme.name: The Shop
theme.blurb: Two rooms with the same rules: you wait your turn, you tip, and you do not touch the chair.

boards.scene: The station, and what is on it

clues.paints: What the shelf looks like from across the room, in eleven colours
clues.satin: The scarf that goes on the second she is out of the chair, before the door
clues.pin: Holding the section she is not working on, and there are nine more in her mouth
clues.tip: Cash, folded, into the hand not holding the shears, and never on the card
clues.sat: Ninety minutes so far, and the appointment was for ten
clues.spin: Of the chair to face the mirror, which is the verdict being delivered

boards.scene: The fade, and the man who will not rush it

clues.fabled: His line-up is, across three neighbourhoods, and the wait proves it
clues.fade: Low, mid or high, and getting that wrong is the one unforgivable thing
clues.blade: Off the guard entirely for the last pass, freehand, near the ear
clues.bald: Where it ends at the bottom, and skin means skin
clues.deal: What the man in the next chair is describing, and it involves a truck
clues.lead: Who has the floor in the argument, which changes about every four minutes

boards.scene: Braids, and the six hours nobody warned you about

clues.bridal: Half the appointments in June, and the deposit is non-refundable
clues.braid: Knotless, waist length, and the quote was for four hours
clues.laid: The edges, with the little brush, and this is the part that gets photographed
clues.bald: What she warns you about if you ask for them any tighter
clues.rail: The back of the chair, where your neck has been for two hours
clues.raid: On the snack bag at hour three, conducted by the stylist, unapologetically

clues.silken: What the press is for, and the argument about whether it is worth it
clues.silk: The press, and the flat iron, and about a week if it does not rain
clues.skin: Of your scalp, which she will tell you about honestly and unprompted
clues.line: Where the new growth starts, and she can see it from the door
clues.sink: The bowl, the cold rim on your neck, and the water finally going warm
clues.kiln: What the dryer feels like at hour two, said by everyone, every time

clues.frayed: The ends, which is why she is talking about a trim you did not book
clues.fade: What the colour does by week five, which is the part nobody budgets for
clues.dye: Mixed in the back, in a bowl, to a shade that has no name on any box
clues.dry: Air, hood or blow, and the answer determines the next ninety minutes
clues.year: How long since the last big change, and she remembers exactly
clues.read: What she does to your face in the mirror before she picks up anything

boards.scene: The regulars, and their standing times

clues.tokens: What the seats become on a Saturday: held, traded, and fiercely defended
clues.knots: Bantu, put in wet on Friday, taken out Sunday morning for the curl
clues.tone: Of the room, set by whoever has been coming longest, not by the owner
clues.set: Standing, same time every three weeks, and it survives house moves
clues.note: On the mirror about the price going up, ignored by everyone including her
clues.stone: What the floor is by four, according to everybody standing on it

boards.scene: The cape, and the rules of the chair

clues.castle: What the chair is, and the person in it is not to be disturbed
clues.lace: The front, laid and cut, and the scissors near your forehead are fine
clues.seat: Yours when he says it is yours, and not one minute before
clues.set: The chair height, pumped up with a foot, without asking
clues.sale: The products by the door, mentioned once, never pushed twice
clues.slate: Wiped between heads, and the next name goes up in marker

boards.scene: Who did not show, and who took the slot

clues.bailed: The eleven o'clock, again, and there is a policy about this now
clues.blade: Cleaned and oiled between heads, and the sound of it is the shop
clues.bald: The joke made at the man in the door, by everyone, immediately
clues.laid: Edges, again, on the woman who took the cancelled slot and cannot believe her luck
clues.idea: Somebody's, about a business, explained at length to a captive room
clues.able: What she says you are, about doing your own edges, and she is being kind
